description: This file manages channel authentication workflows including login and logout, resolving channel plugins, and configuration handling for a CLI tool.

methods.name: supportsChannelAuthMode
methods.description: Checks if a plugin supports a specific channel authentication mode ('login' or 'logout').

methods.name: isConfiguredAuthPlugin
methods.description: Determines if a plugin is properly configured and enabled for authentication based on the current config.

methods.name: resolveConfiguredAuthChannelInput
methods.description: Resolves the channel input based on configured plugins supporting a specific auth mode.

methods.name: resolveChannelPluginForMode
methods.description: Resolves and validates the channel plugin for a given mode ('login' or 'logout') based on options and configuration.

methods.name: resolveAccountContext
methods.description: Resolves the account ID to use for authentication based on plugin and options.

methods.name: runChannelLogin
methods.description: Performs the login process for a specified channel, updating configuration if needed.

methods.name: runChannelLogout
methods.description: Performs the logout process for a specified channel, updating configuration if needed.
